heavy_rain.note: Applied to NASA POWER daily values, which are Local Solar Time days (time_standard=LST), not a rolling 24-hour window; a storm split across two solar days can fall below the value on each day. Rainfall-depth weather metric only: not erosion, runoff or soil loss. Zero-count winters are valid results.
